name: Incentive For The Inter Caste Marriage Couple (Scheduled Tribe)
benefit: An incentive of ₹5,50,000/- is provided to the married couple, i.e. ₹3,00,000/- for the bride and ₹2,50,000/- for the groom.
_eligibility_text:
1. The couple should be residing in Karnataka.
1. The couple should belong to the Hindu religion.
1. One spouse should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community. Other spouse should belong to a community other than Scheduled Tribe (ST).
1. The combined annual income of the couple should be less than ₹5,00,000/-.
1. The couple should apply to the scheme within 18 months of marriage.
1. The non-ST partner should be a Hindu.
1. The non-ST partner should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The marriage should have taken place on or after 7th February 2019.
